name: voice-transcript-screenshots
description: Captures the README screenshots and demo GIFs from the real desktop frontend with Tauri IPC mocked by mock-tauri.js (demo data only). Not part of the pnpm workspace. Start `pnpm --filter desktop dev` first, then `npm install && npm run capture && npm run flow` here; results land in ./out and are copied to docs/screenshots by hand (framed/*.png, and flow-<lang>.gif converted with ffmpeg -- see flow.mjs).

scripts.flow: node flow.mjs ja && node flow.mjs en
